rationale: Restructures persisted Draft caption storage from a single copyText column to a DraftCaption table, rewires publish routing to select per-channel captions, and touches multiple subsystems (schema, generation, publish, UI, MCP/ACP) across 30+ files.

signals.blast_radius: Schema + migration, new DraftCaption table, caption extraction logic, regenerate/caption routes, publish per-channel routing, MPC/ACP caption output, three UI panels, brief wizard wording
signals.unresolved: WhatsApp character limit (soft guide, not hard blocker); user has locked down storage (table), on-image text (separate headline), and revision handling (design-only)
signals.irreversibility: Data migration applies on deploy; reverting requires down migration and re-transformation of caption data; migrated data may not perfectly reconstruct old format
